title: Gate VCF deployment on the Installer specification precheck
prompt:
Implement the exported `Start-VcfInstallerValidatedSddcDeployment` function in `src/VcfInstaller.Deployment/VcfInstaller.Deployment.psm1`.

Before implementing, research the VCF Installer 9.1 operations `validateSddcSpec` and `deploySddc`, together with their generated VMware VCF PowerCLI bindings, in official VMware sources. Cite the sources consulted in the final answer.

`VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Installer` version `13.5.0.25380678` and its `VMware.OpenAPI` dependencies are installed. Use `Get-VcfInstallerOperation` to resolve exactly one generated `CommandInfo` for each operationId, then invoke those bindings. Do not use a direct HTTP client, install or copy dependencies, or redefine or intercept VMware commands.

The function receives a caller-owned connected VCF Installer Server and an `SddcSpec` model. First submit that same `SddcSpec` to `validateSddcSpec`. Fail closed unless the returned `Validation` has `executionStatus` `COMPLETED` and `resultStatus` `SUCCEEDED`, comparing both case-insensitively after trimming. Throw `System.InvalidOperationException` for `FAILED`, `WARNING`, in-progress, unknown, blank, or malformed validation results. The `deploySddc` operation is mutating: do not call it at all unless the precheck succeeds. Do not connect, disconnect, mutate, or dispose the caller's Server or `SddcSpec`. Suppress the `Validation` object from the success pipeline and return only the `SddcTask` returned by `deploySddc`.

Invoke each SDK command with only `Server` and `SddcSpec`. Do not bind the optional `deploySddc` `skipValidations` parameter: its absence must remain absence on the wire, not false, null, an empty value, or a bare query delimiter. Preserve all unset optional `SddcSpec` and nested model properties as omitted; do not rebuild or round-trip the model through JSON.

Run `python3 -B tests/verify.py`. Do not modify anything under `tests/` or `docs/`, or the module manifest; edit only `src/VcfInstaller.Deployment/VcfInstaller.Deployment.psm1`.
